package.description: A powerful tool for installing and upgrading Flutter versions

en-US.description: A powerful tool for installing and upgrading Flutter versions
en-US.longDescription:
Puro is a powerful tool for installing and upgrading Flutter versions, it is essential for developers that work on multiple projects or have slower internet.
With Puro you can:
- Use different versions of Flutter at the same time
- Download new versions twice as fast with significantly less disk space and internet bandwidth
- Use versions globally or per-project
- Automatically configure IDE settings with a single command
en-US.name: Puro

zh-CN.description: 一款强大的 Flutter 版本安装与升级工具
zh-CN.longDescription:
Puro 是一款强大的 Flutter 版本安装与升级工具，特别适合需要同时开发多个项目或网络条件欠佳的开发者。
通过 Puro 您可以：
- 同时使用多个不同版本的 Flutter
- 以双倍速度下载新版本，显著节省磁盘空间和网络带宽
- 支持全局或按项目单独配置版本
- 只需一条命令即可自动配置 IDE 设置
